name: @educateos/sandbox-runner
description: EducateOS assessment sandbox runner (SCHO-144): the Worker and per-job Durable Object that `createCloudflareSandbox` in @educateos/assessment-ai targets. It carries out the adapter's decisions (instance type, wall-clock bound, output cap, egress rule) on one container per job and answers with a RunnerJobResponse. Code and tests only: it has no Worker config and deploys nowhere until the SCHO-102 spike verifies it on a sandbox account.
